title: POV: You Finally Control the AI
description:
POV: you finally control what the AI draws. ArtCraft is a free, open-source AI film studio: you pose your characters and place the camera first, then generate, and the poses guide the picture. Keep the same room for every shot, or turn any picture into a 3D prop. It picked up over 3,000 GitHub stars in a day.

Full breakdown: https://youtu.be/SgS1dlVNm1s
Source: https://github.com/storytold/artcraft
AI voice from ElevenLabs (elevenlabs.io), AI music. Animated in code; the painted shots are illustrations. Not affiliated with ArtCraft.

#ArtCraft #AIArt #Shorts
